name: cure
description: Cure Consulting Group's private plugin marketplace — the product engineering skill library and tooling.

plugins.name: cure-product-engineering
plugins.description: Complete product engineering skill library — 106 skills (domain-organized), 41 agents (engineering, product, marketing, business, data, security), 4 personas (cross-domain engagement archetypes), 11 rules, 9 output styles, multi-layer hooks with agent auto-triggering, bundled stdlib Python tooling, MCP + LSP servers. Standards for Android, iOS, Web, Firebase, Python, Go, Rust, Docker, Terraform, and cloud infrastructure.

plugins.name: cure-tri-lane
plugins.description: Opt-in multi-vendor orchestration: Claude architect, Codex implementation and correctness lanes (codex exec), Antigravity system-review lane (agy) in read-only worktrees, and a fresh-context advisor. Uses existing ChatGPT and Google logins; independent of cure-product-engineering.

plugins.name: cure-policy-guard
plugins.description: Mod: refuses file writes that break a written Cure house rule unless you override; overrides are recorded.

plugins.name: cure-lane-verifier
plugins.description: Mod: attaches git's evidence to subagent and lane reports; flags a 'complete' with an empty branch.

plugins.name: cure-spend-band
plugins.description: Mod: today's GitHub Actions spend beside the spinner, a pace warning, and /spend.

plugins.name: cure-cache-band
plugins.description: Mod: prompt cache time left, hit rate and misses above the prompt; says what a cold next message re-caches. Adds /cache.

plugins.name: cure-image-viewer
plugins.description: Mod: draws the images you paste above the prompt until the turn that sent them ends.
